notes: sort_on=score: results are always returned in descending order regardless of sort_order; sort_on/sort_order only work together with a search option such as keywords (spec text).
findAllListingsActive has NO 'includes' parameter; use getListingsByListingIds (listings/batch, includes=Images,Shop,...) to attach images/shop and the 'views' field.
Shop.review_count / review_average cover reviews of shop listings in the past year (spec text), not lifetime; Shop.transaction_sold_count is the lifetime sales count.
ShopListing in the 2026 spec has no 'views' field (it only appears in ShopListingWithAssociations from listings/batch).
Max limit is 100 per call for all list endpoints above; paginate with offset.
